name: Unofficial Forces of Corruption Patch (UFCP)
summary: A comprehensive bugfixing mod for Forces of Corruption.

steamdata.title: Unofficial Forces of Corruption Patch (UFoCP)
steamdata.description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AEiBnVz.png[/img]
The Unofficial Forces of Corruption Patch is a one-does-all community patch for Forces of Corruption.  UFCP's goal is to correct as many errors possible, to whatever limit is possible with the modders' toolset, in one convenient package.

Features:
[list]
[*]Many and various gameplay, audio and text fixes and built from the ground to be true to Petroglyph's original vision.
[*]Open source project on GitHub.
[*]Changes are made as neutrally as possible, with enhancements/"iffy" changes voted for by the community on the EaW Community Discord.
[*]Designed as a modular base for all prospective mods that want to start off with a bugfixed vanilla game.
[*]A comprehensive set of readmes and changelogs can be found in the main directory, with links to the original bug reports so nothing goes untracked.  These files are also found in UFCP's GitHub.
[*]Multiple compatible addons for customization (see the two above mod groups).
[/list]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eiz0azy.png[/img]
[b][u]Q - UFCP Doesn't Launch from the "Mods" Menu[/u][/b]
A - Try one or a combination of these fixes:
1). Ensure Forces of Corruption isn't installed in a [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_Account_Control]UAC-protected folder (such as "Program Files (x86)").[/url]  Your Windows permission settings may be preventing FoC from relaunching.
2). Run the game in windowed mode.
3). Set Forces of Corruption's EXE file properties (runme2.exe, StarWarsG.exe, swfoc.exe) to launch as an administrator.

Otherwise, run the mod directly with the launch option [b]STEAMMOD=1548018187[/b]


[b][u]Q - How do I know UFCP is Working?[/u][/b]
A (v2.0+) - As of 2.0, UFCP has a customized loading screen and a recreated HD main menu texture.  It should be very obvious if the mod has launched.

A (v1.0+) - Launch the game, enter the "Equal Footing" Galactic Conquest as the Empire on Hard, and remove corruption with Grand Admiral Thrawn.  If the announcer is the Female Rebel voice, the patch is [b]not working[/b] (it should be the Male Empire voice).


[b][u]Q - Does this mod use AI?[/u][/b]
A - AI slop shall not touch this mod inshallah


[img]https://i.imgur.com/DepXmJm.png[/img]
